summary: Frontend-only sweep for iteration_116. The OWNER GRAPH CORRECTION and all three LANE C modernized surfaces PASS. (1) Graph canvas on /xdr/incidents/inc_c312e0180ec742778b6b?tab=entities is a true scroll container (scrollWidth=1152>clientWidth=1098, scrollHeight=1787>clientHeight=778) and programmatic scrollLeft/scrollTop actually pans the SVG to full extent; mouse wheel does NOT change the zoom readout (100% before=100% after); press-and-drag does NOT pan the content (scrollLeft/scrollTop=0 after drag); +/- buttons step zoom in 10% increments (100->110->svg 1267x1960, then 110->90); center resets to 100% at origin; fit-to-view produced 44%; HUD stays absolutely pinned (dx=dy=0 while canvas scrolls); legend renders when toggled. (2) Entities workspace still fully mounts — incident-entities-workspace + inv-graph-canvas + 35 inv-graph-node-* + inv-entities-advanced (legacy graph) + all 7 left-rail controls (Center/Fit/Expand selection/Show neighbors/Show all paths/Group similar/Show legend) + zoom-in/-out; node click opens inv-entity-pane with all 4 tabs (details/relationships/evidence/context). (3) /xdr/hunting — xdr-hunting-page, xdr-hunting-idle + xdr-hunting-surfaces on empty; xdr-hunting-unsupported reads 'WHAT THIS PLATFORM CANNOT HUNT YET — STATED, NOT HIDDEN', xdr-hunting-not-searchable reads 'ENTITIES WITH NO INDEX'. Hunt latency is ~5s. Nonsense term -> state='NO_MATCH', total='0', xdr-hunting-no-match rendered with correct text. Incident id inc_c312e0180ec742778b6b -> state='RESULTS' total=1 classification='INCIDENT_REFERENCE' (INC000001378 opened). Hostname agent-env-630704a1-... -> 1 row + 1 chip. Row click opens xdr-hunting-pane with tabs details/context/technical + xdr-hunting-pane-open. (4) /xdr/intelligence/threat — xdr-ti-stat-total='117,225' (real, not 0), xdr-ti-stat-sources='9 of 11', xdr-ti-stat-errors='3'; xdr-ti-by-type chips render real counts (ip 65,282 / url 35,976 / domain 3,563 / sha256 2,475 / md5 1,320 / sha1 902); xdr-ti-sources-table has per-source rows and honest error rows xdr-ti-source-abuseipdb-error='HTTP 429', xdr-ti-source-talos-error='HTTP 403', xdr-ti-source-threatfox-error='HTTP 401'; xdr-ti-iocs-table + xdr-ti-search + xdr-ti-kind + xdr-ti-count + xdr-ti-refresh all present; ioc row click opens xdr-ti-pane with tabs -details and -technical. Type chip click filters. (5) /xdr/intelligence/iocs — xdr-ioc-intel-page, xdr-ioc-stat-live='7 of 7', xdr-ioc-stat-cache='NOT RECORDED' (honest), xdr-ioc-stat-state='reachable'; xdr-ioc-providers-table lists 7 providers all data-state=live (virustotal/abuseipdb/urlscan/hybrid-analysis/malwarebazaar/threatfox/urlhaus); Enrich 8.8.8.8/ip -> xdr-ioc-result rendered, xdr-ioc-answers-empty='NO PER-PROVIDER ATTRIBUTION' (honest — fabric answered without per-provider structure), xdr-ioc-raw present, xdr-ioc-enrich-error NOT shown. Deep link ?incident_id=inc_c312e0180ec742778b6b -> xdr-ioc-incident-context reads 'Arrived from incident inc_c312e0180ec742778b6b — Per-incident indicator correlation is not wired yet…' (honest). (6) SHELL regression: hard refresh on /xdr/hunting, /xdr/intelligence/threat and /xdr/intelligence/iocs — sidebar=true, tenant-pill=true, scope-navigator-error=false, body innerText>0 on every route; no 'destroy is not a function' in console. (7) HONESTY sweep: NO bare 0s in any of the three modernized stat headers. On a second load of /xdr/intelligence/iocs after CF backoff, the health call was rate-limited and the stat card correctly degraded to PROVIDERS LIVE=NOT AVAILABLE / CACHE=NOT RECORDED / SERVICE=NOT AVAILABLE — honest, not a defect. Overlays API round-trip: 4 GET /api/incidents/{id}/intelligence/overlays all 200. REG5 in-browser Edit->Save->Revert round-trip could NOT be exercised on ?tab=activity because clicking a row in inv-findings-table on that tab navigates to the Evidence tab surface rather than opening a right-hand findings pane — the mounted overlay editor was not reachable via that path in this run (see action_items).

ui_bugs.component: Activity tab findings row click behavior
ui_bugs.issue: On /xdr/incidents/{id}?tab=activity the inv-findings-table renders 6 rows, but clicking the first row navigates the surrounding tab to Evidence (which shows '0 item(s) across 0 domain(s)' and no findings pane) rather than opening a right-side inv-findings-pane with the interpretation tab. Because of this, the newly-added data-ovr-action=edit|save|revert|history|value|reason selectors on IntelligenceOverlayEditor could not be exercised via UI from this route in this run. The overlays API itself is healthy (4/4 GET returned 200).

action_items: OPTIONAL — Confirm the intended surface for the analyst-overlay editor round-trip. On /xdr/incidents/{id}?tab=activity the findings row click navigates rather than opens a pane, so the interpretation tab and the data-ovr-action controls are not reachable through that path. If the editor is meant to live on a different tab (e.g. detections, or a dedicated inv-findings-pane invoked from an 'Open' action, not the row body), please point testing at the correct entry point so REG5 can be exercised end-to-end.
NONE for the graph correction — every acceptance check passed.
NONE for the three modernized pages — every stat / testid / disclosure required in this iteration is present and honest.
critical_code_review_comments: NxGraphCanvas.jsx correctly removed wheel/drag handlers; the SVG is sized (extent.w*k, extent.h*k) inside a .inv-cv overflow:auto container, and .inv-cv__hud / .inv-cv__legend are absolutely positioned outside the scroll area. The scroll-extent contract (scrollWidth>clientWidth, scrollHeight>clientHeight) holds at 100% zoom and grows with +/- as expected.

XdrHuntingPage.jsx correctly renders xdr-hunting-no-match only when data.state==='NO_MATCH'; on RESULTS it renders classification, chips, table, and pane with 3 tabs plus xdr-hunting-pane-open. Only nit: the busy state can take up to ~5s on this preview host — automated tests must wait for [data-testid=xdr-hunting-busy] to disappear before asserting on results.
XdrThreatIntelPage.jsx exposes real values (117,225 indicators; per-source error rows carrying the HTTP status the source actually returned) — no bare 0 or dash on total.

XdrIocIntelPage.jsx honestly renders NOT AVAILABLE on the stat card when /api/ioc/health is unreachable (CF 429) instead of falling back to 0 — matches owner rule. The per-provider answers table correctly disappears in favour of xdr-ioc-answers-empty when the fabric answers without a per-provider structure, and the verbatim response is exposed under xdr-ioc-raw. Good.
Overlays API traffic is quiet on this iteration (4 GETs, all 200) — no chatter regression.
